name: Landscape Design III
brief: Investigate the landscape and urban-water relationships around Küçükçekmece. Define the exact study area with your course materials and inspect water edges, settlement, vegetation, mobility and public space. Study the wider watershed only where relevant and supported. Establish an independent design argument and programme. Do not assume access, water quality, flood levels, land ownership or an approved shoreline intervention without evidence.
provenance: Generic site starter based on the project location. The official Landscape Design III syllabus and surveyed boundary are not included; add the current materials for your own project.
